Title: Beryl's Macadamia Chocolate at Don Quijote Is Actually a Halal-Certified Malaysian Brand

Description:
This macadamia chocolate from a Don Quijote shelf in Osaka is made by Beryl's, a Malaysian brand founded in 1995 that's now sold in 18 countries and regions. It only reached Japanese supermarkets in November 2025, and 28 of those stores even set up a special corner just for Halal-certified chocolate — the mark on the box is Malaysia's official Halal standard, MS 1500. Japanese reviewers say the almond coating is thick with a strong milk flavor, and one reviewer admitted they didn't expect much from a Malaysian product — until they found out it's actually a premium gift chocolate back home, even served as an in-flight snack.
